# GTM Alpha

> GTM Alpha scores a company's go-to-market motion with Shashwat Ghosh's EPIC framework (Ecosystem and ABM, Product-Led Growth, Inbound and Outbound Demand Generation, Community-Led Advocacy), each from 1 to 10, and names the motion to lead with. By Helix GTM Consulting.

- MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in, read-only tools): https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/mcp
- Hosted version 1.3.21 with 3 tools. Local stdio command: `npx -y @shashwatgtmalpha/gtm-alpha-mcp-server`. npm latest on 15 November 2026: 1.3.20.
- Setup for Claude, ChatGPT and other assistants: https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/integration
- API and tool documentation: https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/api-docs
- Free EPIC audit (web form, report with a 180 day plan): https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/consultation
- Pricing (free during testing): https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/pricing
- FAQ: https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/faq
- Privacy policy: https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/privacy

## Tools

- EPIC motion scores and first 30 days (`gtm_consultation`): Helps you decide which go to market motion to lead with and what to do first. You give your main GTM challenge, plus your stage and industry and the optional ACV, deal cycle, NRR, TAM, self serve, deal source and geography for a full score. You get a score from 1 to 10 for each of the four EPIC motions from the documented rubric, the primary and secondary motion and the first 30 days of steps for the primary motion, with sector notes when your inputs name the sector. Without the optional inputs the result is marked preliminary.
- EPIC scores (`epic_audit`): Helps you decide which go to market motion fits your company. You give your GTM challenge, plus your stage and industry and the optional inputs (ACV, deal cycle, NRR, TAM, self serve, deal source, geography) for a full score. You get EPIC scores from 1 to 10 for Ecosystem and ABM, Product-Led Growth, Inbound and Outbound, and Community-Led, the lead motion, warnings and notes, and the sector's buying committee and usual objections when your inputs name the sector. Without the optional inputs the result is marked preliminary.
- GTM Roadmap (`generate_roadmap`): Helps you decide what to do in the next 30, 60 or 90 days for one motion. You give the EPIC motion (E Ecosystem and ABM, P Product-Led Growth, I Inbound and Outbound, C Community-Led) and the time frame. You get immediate, short term and medium term steps, without the self serve steps when your business model is not a software subscription. It builds text from your inputs only.

## Questions and answers

### What is GTM Alpha?

GTM Alpha is a go-to-market tool by Shashwat Ghosh of Helix GTM Consulting. It scores four GTM motions with the EPIC framework (Ecosystem and ABM, Product-Led Growth, Inbound and Outbound Demand Generation, Community-Led Advocacy) from 1 to 10 and names the motion to lead with. It runs as an MCP server for Claude and other AI assistants, and as a free EPIC audit report on this site with a 180 day plan in four stages.

### How is the EPIC score calculated?

Each motion starts from a default for the company's stage (Seed, Series A, Series B, Series C or later, Bootstrapped). Fixed adjustments follow for contract value, deal cycle, net revenue retention, number of addressable accounts, self-serve, main deal source and region. Product-Led is capped at 4 in logistics, procurement, manufacturing, healthcare and government. Scores are kept between 1 and 10, then three checks can add a warning: a leaky bucket, AI search disruption of inbound, and a hybrid motion. The company name never affects the score.

### How do I use GTM Alpha in Claude?

In Claude, open Customize, then Connectors, then Add custom connector, and paste https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/mcp with no sign-in. In Claude Code run: claude mcp add --transport http gtm-alpha https://gtmalpha.gtmhelix.com/mcp. Then ask, for example: Use GTM Alpha to run an EPIC audit on our GTM.

### Is GTM Alpha free?

Yes, while it is in testing. The MCP tools are free and need no account, and the free EPIC audit report is shown straight after the form, with no payment step.

### What data does GTM Alpha keep?

The MCP server stores and logs none of your inputs or results. The free EPIC audit form keeps only the GTM challenge, with the company domain, for 90 days, and only when a company website is given; its other answers build your report in that request and are then dropped. The EPIC audit API does not keep new audits; older records are deleted on request within 30 days. The privacy policy lists every field.

### Who is behind GTM Alpha?

Shashwat Ghosh, Co-Founder and Fractional CMO of Helix GTM Consulting, the brand he has worked under in Bengaluru since 2022. He has 24+ years in B2B and 10+ years of fractional experience, and created the EPIC, IMPACT and CRAFT frameworks and the Hub-Spoke Brand Messaging Methodology.

### Which other MCP connectors does Helix GTM Consulting offer?

CRAFT GTM (go-to-market planning), CRAFT Content (B2B content), IMPACT (positioning), ICP Intelligence (ideal customer profile) and Revenue Enablement (sales enablement). Each is a free, read-only MCP server for Claude.
